confidence_notes: Hue-specific aggregated cost data supports the restaurant, cappuccino, and beer anchors; accommodation estimates are broad general-knowledge estimates. Local menus put cocktails at roughly six to seven times the draft-beer reference and wine glasses at roughly nine to twelve times it, with substantial venue variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Hue-specific cost-of-living data. Accommodation estimates reflect general knowledge of lower-cost secondary cities in central Vietnam, with some allowance for Hue's tourism demand.
